disambiguation: Not merely a chart generator, Vivid provides a comprehensive suite for interactive data visualization and knowledge graph integration.
extras: 100% Offline Core and Local-First Storage; zero external CDN loads, zero telemetry, and zero analytics.
intentEvidence: Vivid bridges AI-generated outputs directly into first-class Obsidian .base databases, .canvas whiteboards, metadataCache analytics, and live [[Wikilink]] knowledge graphs.
problem: Existing visualization plugins often isolate diagrams within a single note, failing to connect rich AI outputs with native Obsidian database or canvas features.
summary: Vivid provides interactive, AI-generated visual rendering for Markdown notes, integrating super-tables, charts, and canvases directly into the Obsidian vault.
